svg.title: The whole app — ask, process, and explore
svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. The browser sends questions and recent context to the app server. The server coordinates an AI provider and checked read-only database access. Progress and SQL appear while work continues, followed by an answer, table, or clear error. Schema browsing, cancellation, follow-ups, and local table actions complete the user journey.
